# addyosmani

These skills are copied from https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills at commit
`8c99fa36d90068c82d547f7c12a9d67a3e95f4ee`, under the MIT license.
The upstream license is in `LICENSE` beside this file.

RooAGI sets `license` and `source` in each SKILL.md frontmatter, renames a skill
to `addyosmani-<name>` when another skill already has its name, and may append a
"RooAGI notes" section from `notes/addyosmani/`; the rest is unchanged.
